fact: On 21 March 2025 the Minister announced LEAP payments for the 94th and 95th cycles to 350,000 households, disbursed via GhIPSS to beneficiaries' E-Zwich accounts, with reassessment supported by the Ghana National Household Registry.
title: Minister's press briefing on the 94th and 95th LEAP disbursement
publisher: Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection
